decisive_items: predominantly plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
response.rationale: Multiple subcutaneous spindle-cell nodules with collagenous matrix and no atypia favor neurofibroma; nodular fasciitis is less likely due to lack of inflammation and longer duration.

rejected.why: Clinical impression only, cytology lacks lymphoid cells.
Lipomatosis would show adipocytes, not spindle cells.
Elastofibroma typically subscapular, not multiple cervical/abdominal.
DFSP usually solitary, storiform pattern, not described.
Hibernoma has brown fat cells, not spindle cells.
Fibromatosis is deeper, infiltrative, not multiple mobile subcutaneous nodules.
Nodular fasciitis often painful, short duration, mixed inflammation.
No family history or other NF1 stigmata.
Lipoma would show mature fat cells, not spindle cells.
